title: Angular type-check executor
description: Type-checks an Angular project (TypeScript + template + extended NG8xxx) with no emit.

tsConfig.description: Path (or array of paths) to the tsconfig(s) to type-check. Resolved relative to the workspace root when not absolute.

includeDeps.description: Include out-of-project and node_modules diagnostics. Default excludes them.

maxWarnings.description: Fail when the warning count exceeds this number. 0 fails on any warning. Omit to never fail on warnings alone.

failFast.description: Report only the first error (output brevity) - NOT a speed-up; all diagnostics are still gathered.

strict.description: Opt-in strict mode: FAIL with the coverage-incomplete outcome when a dropped first-party in-graph warning would otherwise leave the verdict clean. By default such a dropped in-graph warning does not fail on its own (it stays clean unless maxWarnings gates it). strict only adds a fail path; it never turns a fail into a pass.

format.description: Output format. human (default) is the colorized codeframe report; json is the machine-readable payload; sarif lands in a later release.
